documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our manufacturing team is exploring options. We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner. Please clarify what we need before arranging a discovery meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's manufacturing team is exploring options but has not identified a specific requirement or project owner. This lack of clarity is creating operational friction, as they request clarification before proceeding with a discovery meeting.

claims.quote: We have not identified a specific requirement or project owner.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your manufacturing team is currently exploring options, but there is no specific requirement or project owner identified yet. To ensure we address the right needs, could you clarify what specific challenges or goals you're looking to solve with Cedar Systems? This will help us prepare for a discovery meeting that aligns with your priorities.
questions: What specific challenges or goals is your manufacturing team looking to address with workflow coordination or account reporting?
Is there a particular department or individual who would be responsible for this project?
uncertainties: The lack of a defined requirement or project owner may delay or complicate the discovery process.
